name: DOE SULI
eligibility: U.S. citizen or LPR at application; review GPA, credits, enrollment and participation limits.
materials: Transcripts, application essays and two online recommendations; verify current instructions.
action: Apply through WDTS; choose hosts using research fit. Mentor outreach is useful but does not replace the application.

name: DOE CCI
eligibility: Community college/two-year college enrollment; U.S. citizen or LPR; check current academic requirements.
materials: Transcripts, application responses and recommendations through the WDTS portal.
action: Contact the host education office about technical projects and the applicable term.

name: DOE SCGSR
eligibility: U.S. citizen or LPR; PhD candidacy and a defined thesis; a terminal master’s alone is ineligible.
materials: Co-developed research proposal, thesis-advisor support and required academic records.
action: Establish a collaborating lab scientist and coordinate with your thesis advisor before applying.

name: DOE Visiting Faculty Program
focus: STEM faculty research and student teams
eligibility: Faculty and student eligibility differ; check citizenship and institutional restrictions. R1/R2 exclusion has an HBCU exception.
materials: Research proposal co-developed with a lab scientist; separate student applications when applicable.
action: Faculty should contact a lab collaborator early. This is a faculty-led route, not a general student internship.

name: Sandia internships & co-ops
focus: Engineering, computing, physical sciences and business
eligibility: Some positions accept international students at U.S. universities with existing work authorization; Sandia does not sponsor internship work authorization. Citizenship applies to specified roles.
materials: Resume, enrollment information and posting-specific academic materials.
action: Apply separately to each job. Ask the recruiter about citizenship and project-access requirements.

name: Oak Ridge Research Student Internships
eligibility: Current RSI page lists U.S. citizen or LPR, age 18+, GPA 3.0 and undergraduate/graduate/recent-graduate status.
materials: Follow the current RSI application for required academic records and research interests.
action: Use the RSI office for eligibility; identify a research group before sending a focused mentor inquiry.

name: LANL Undergraduate Student Program
focus: Science, engineering, computing and professional fields
eligibility: Domestic and international students are included; project access and individual posting restrictions still apply.
materials: Resume, transcript and enrollment/course information required by the posting.
action: Search undergraduate internship openings; cite the job ID in recruiter or mentor correspondence.

name: LANL Graduate Research Assistant
focus: Graduate research and possible thesis collaboration
eligibility: Domestic and international graduate students; hiring and site-access approval are position-specific.
materials: Graduate CV, research summary and required academic documentation.
action: Discuss thesis alignment and publication expectations with both advisors before committing.

name: Idaho National Laboratory internships
focus: Nuclear energy, cybersecurity, engineering and science
eligibility: Minimum 3.0 GPA; enrollment rules apply. INL lists CPT authorization for international students at U.S. institutions.
materials: Resume/CV, latest transcripts and current class schedule or qualifying graduation record.
action: Ask University Recruiting about a matching role; confirm the posting and authorization process.

name: LLNL Computing internships
focus: HPC, cybersecurity, software and machine learning
eligibility: U.S. citizens and foreign nationals depending on position; age 18+; verify site-access restrictions.
materials: Resume, transcripts and references when requested; demonstrate relevant programming projects.
action: Use the Computing internship page to reach live job postings and program contacts.

name: LLNL Data Science Summer Institute
eligibility: Program accepts U.S. citizens and foreign nationals, subject to access restrictions; review the current posting.
materials: CV/resume, academic background and evidence of data-science preparation.
action: Contact DSSI through its official page about the current cohort and access rules.

name: Berkeley Lab Computing Sciences summer program
focus: Scientific computing, networking and data science
eligibility: Undergraduate and graduate route; confirm citizenship, work authorization and academic requirements in the active posting.
materials: Resume/CV, computing projects and posting-specific academic materials.
action: Follow CSASP links from the Berkeley Lab education catalog.

name: Berkeley Lab ScienceIT internships
eligibility: Review the individual ScienceIT opportunity for degree level, work authorization and citizenship.
materials: Resume and technical portfolio; additional materials depend on the opening.
action: Read the ScienceIT graduate and embedded research support pathways before contacting the program.

name: PNNL Project Interns
eligibility: College and graduate students; eligibility and closing dates vary by job. Citizenship is not established for every role by the overview.
materials: Follow the Project Interns page and job posting for the required PDF package.
action: Search PNNL careers for intern; match your skills to an individual project.

name: PNNL National Security Internship Program
eligibility: Undergraduate and graduate pathway; security and citizenship requirements must be checked for each opening.
materials: Research-focused resume and required academic materials.
action: Use the NSIP link in PNNL’s internship catalog to find the current program and openings.

name: Argonne Research Aide appointments
eligibility: Argonne’s student-opportunities material includes non-U.S. citizens; each position still has its own employment/access requirements.
materials: CV/resume, transcript and job-specific evidence of technical skills.
action: Find current research aide roles through Argonne careers; ask about the team’s immediate skill needs.

name: Berkeley Lab Foundry Undergraduate Summer Experience
eligibility: FUSE is described for UC Berkeley undergraduates; confirm current cohort and authorization requirements.
materials: Research interests and materials requested by the Foundry program.
action: Contact the Molecular Foundry program office about availability before investing in an application.

name: Brookhaven Science Communication internship
eligibility: Confirm degree level, citizenship and current recruitment with the program; this is a communication route rather than a bench-research appointment.
materials: Writing samples and resume; follow current application instructions.
action: Use the Science Communication link on Brookhaven’s college-student catalog.

name: Fermilab Computational Science Internship
eligibility: Graduate enrollment in a U.S. institution in CS or related field, GPA 3.0+ and eligibility to work in the U.S.
materials: Resume, unofficial transcript and online application.
action: 2027 application window listed as November 3, 2026–January 18, 2027; confirm current page and portal cutoff.

name: Fermilab ASPIRE
eligibility: U.S. citizen or permanent resident; engineering juniors/seniors or master’s students; GPA 3.0+.
materials: Official transcript, personal statement, proposed residency schedule and one recommendation.
action: 2027 initial residency is planned; application dates are listed TBD. Ask about residency compatibility.

name: SLAC Summer Internship Program
eligibility: Work authorization in the U.S. and background check; additional restrictions may apply to an individual job.
materials: Resume and the materials required by the selected job.
action: Search SLAC careers for intern and apply to the specific position.

name: PPPL Operations Internship Program
lab: Princeton Plasma Physics Lab · New Jersey
focus: Operations, health physics, energy management and support
eligibility: Eligible to work in the U.S.; review enrollment/recent-graduate requirements. This program is distinct from PPPL SULI research.
materials: Resume and individual posting requirements.
action: Look for rolling project postings through Princeton careers.

name: Jefferson Lab / ODU REU
eligibility: Undergraduate pathway; confirm citizenship/funding eligibility with the active REU announcement.
materials: Academic records, research interests and recommendations as requested.
action: Follow the accelerator-science REU link from Jefferson Lab’s official programs page.

name: Jefferson Lab EIC Graduate Fellowship
eligibility: Full-time enrollment in a relevant doctoral program; check current citizenship, funding and collaboration conditions.
materials: Research plan, advisor coordination and current fellowship requirements.
action: Contact the program through the EIC fellowship link; establish project relevance first.

name: Ames METALLIC internships
focus: Critical materials, manufacturing and supply chains
eligibility: Undergraduate and graduate students; overview does not settle citizenship/authorization for every project.
materials: Resume, interests and the application materials specified by the active call.
action: Ask Ames Education and Outreach about available projects and current eligibility.

name: SRNL ASPIRE / direct internships
eligibility: SRNL direct-internship overview specifies U.S. citizenship and full-time four-year college/university enrollment.
materials: Resume, academic records and position-specific documents.
action: Use SRNL’s open positions and internship program office; distinguish direct internships from WDTS routes.

name: NETL Professional Internship Program
lab: National Energy Technology Lab · multiple sites
eligibility: NETL lists U.S. citizens or foreign nationals age 18+; review the particular opportunity’s restrictions.
materials: CV/resume, transcripts and application materials listed on the active ORISE opportunity.
action: Contact the NETL internship office and use the official open-opportunity links.

name: NLR Research Participant Program
lab: National Laboratory of the Rockies · Colorado
eligibility: Formerly searched as NREL. GPA 3.0 and enrollment requirements apply; check citizenship/work authorization in each posting.
materials: Resume, transcript and individual posting requirements.
action: Filter jobs by Intern; contact Workforce Development about enrollment or program questions.

name: Mickey Leland Energy Fellowship
eligibility: NETL’s current catalog lists undergraduate and master’s students; U.S. citizen, age 18+; consult active solicitation.
materials: Research interests, academic documentation and requested references.
action: Use the MLEF link in NETL’s program table; verify host locations for the current cycle.

name: PNNL Energy and Environment Internship Program
eligibility: Check the current EEIP posting for degree, citizenship and work-authorization criteria; the catalog alone is insufficient.
materials: Resume, relevant coursework/research and current posting requirements.
action: Follow EEIP from PNNL’s internship catalog and identify a matching technical area.
